featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
"Dear Ma'am,

Thank you for your feedback. I want to clarify a few things. You provided the flooring tiles, and we only handled the labor for the flooring. We did not do the waterproofing or painting, which might be causing the leakage issues. The water is coming from outside, specifically from the terrace, and I had mentioned this before as a possible future problem.

The damage to the paint and the furniture is because of the water leaking down the wall. Wet walls can hurt the furniture, and this is something beyond our control. Since we didn’t do the painting or waterproofing, any damage from this leakage is also beyond our control.

Regarding communication, I did reply to your message saying I would call, and I tried to reach out, but I didn’t get a response. I am still here if you want to discuss this further.

I always aim to provide good service and have not had similar issues with other clients. Please feel free to reach out if you need any more help.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Gohar -Dream House Renovation]"
